title: combat_text
summary: MSUI implements the core WORLDTEXTSTRING observables: floating text is world-anchored over the recipient at overhead height, capped at 4 concurrent per unit as a hard drop (MaxWorldTextPerUnit), self-source-only (Gate A: only the local player's outgoing damage floats; another unit's fight floats nothing), miss/dodge/parry/block/absorb/resist words, the melee-white vs spell-gold color split, crit flagged, and the XP text self-anchored. Heals never float over the world (matching 5875).

openItems.text: Pet damage never floats: WorldText requires attacker == playerGuid, so an owned pet's hits show nothing - the reference floats pet melee ORANGE (0xFFFF8400) and pet spell GOLD under their own cvars.

The category timing/scale/fade table is replaced by one flat 1.5 s lifetime: no per-category rise rates, no crit park-and-pop scale animation (~70 px peak settling to 35 px), no plateau/fade-in/fade-out alpha law or shadow law.
The ranged-basic-shot exception (AttributesEx3 bit-15 -> Auto Shot/Throw numbers float white off the spell-damage log) is not applied - all spell-log damage styles gold.
